<!-- reusable commands section -->
<!-- exec replaces the local shell so SSH owns the terminal and ends when it closes.
     EOS runs remote bash commands through an extra PTY. Put the original SSH_TTY
     in raw mode to avoid duplicate echo, then clear and start the authorized CLI.
     Readable data-args attributes double backslashes for Markdown parsing;
     the rendered attribute must contain valid JSON. -->
[lab-terminals]: command:runCommands {data-args='[{"commands":["workbench.action.focusFirstEditorGroup","workbench.action.closeEditorsInOtherGroups",{"command":"vscode.setEditorLayout","args":{"orientation":0,"groups":[{"size":0.666667},{"size":0.333333,"groups":[{"size":0.333333},{"size":0.333333},{"size":0.333334}]}]}},{"command":"workbench.action.createTerminalEditor","args":{"config":{"name":"Lab shell"},"location":{"viewColumn":1}}},{"command":"workbench.action.createTerminalEditor","args":{"config":{"name":"SSH admin@EOS1"},"location":{"viewColumn":2}}},{"command":"workbench.action.terminal.sendSequence","args":{"text":"exec ssh -t admin@EOS1 \\"bash stty raw -echo -F \\\\$SSH_TTY; clear; exec /usr/bin/RunCli\\"\\r"}},{"command":"workbench.action.createTerminalEditor","args":{"config":{"name":"SSH admin@EOS2"},"location":{"viewColumn":3}}},{"command":"workbench.action.terminal.sendSequence","args":{"text":"exec ssh -t admin@EOS2 \\"bash stty raw -echo -F \\\\$SSH_TTY; clear; exec /usr/bin/RunCli\\"\\r"}}]}]'}

## 🔐 SSH to Nodes {#connect-to-nodes .unlisted .unnumbered}

Choose a node, then use **Open terminals** to connect as `admin` beside the
preview. Complete any SSH login prompts; the screen clears after login.
**Close terminals** resets the side editor tabs. Opening another set replaces
those tabs, including any non-terminal documents. Logging out closes the SSH
terminal; button labels follow clicks, not connection state.

**Router**

<button id="terminal-toggle" type="button" class="btn btn-primary">
  Open terminals
</button>

<script>
const button = document.getElementById("terminal-toggle");
let opened = false;

button.addEventListener("click", () => {
  document.getElementById(
    opened ? "terminal-close-action" : "terminal-open-action"
  ).click();

  opened = !opened;
  button.textContent = opened ? "Close terminals" : "Open terminals";
});
</script>
